title: What are your favourite famous sites? 🎡 | Improve your listening with Real Easy English

sentences.en: Hi Georgie.
sentences.ko: 안녕, 조지.

sentences.en: Hi Phil. How are you?
sentences.ko: 안녕, 필. 잘 지내?

sentences.en: I'm good, I'm good.
sentences.ko: 잘 지내, 잘 지내.

sentences.en: I wanted to ask if you've been to any famous places or landmarks in London recently.
sentences.ko: 최근에 런던의 유명한 장소나 명소(landmarks)에 가봤는지 물어보고 싶었어.

sentences.en: It's funny you should ask, because I did.
sentences.ko: 마침 그걸 물어보다니 재밌네, 갔었거든.

sentences.en: A few days ago, I went to the Royal Albert Hall, which is a famous concert hall in London.
sentences.ko: 며칠 전에 런던의 유명한 공연장인 로열 앨버트 홀에 갔어.

sentences.en: OK. So, Georgie, today we're talking about landmarks – British landmarks.
sentences.ko: 좋아. 그래서 조지, 오늘은 명소, 영국의 명소에 대해 이야기할 거야.

sentences.en: Now, those are famous buildings like the Royal Albert Hall or like...
sentences.ko: 명소란 로열 앨버트 홀이나...

sentences.en: like Big Ben in London.
sentences.ko: 런던의 빅벤 같은 유명한 건물들이야.

sentences.en: That's a really famous landmark that everyone knows.
sentences.ko: 모두가 아는 정말 유명한 명소지.

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a famous clock tower, but before we start talking about landmarks, I need to remind people that they can download a free worksheet to test the vocabulary they learn in this programme, at bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: 맞아, 유명한 시계탑이지. 그런데 명소 얘기를 시작하기 전에, 이 프로그램에서 배운 어휘를 테스트할 수 있는 무료 워크시트를 bbclearningenglish.com에서 받을 수 있다는 걸 알려드려야 해요.

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.ko: 좋아.

sentences.en: So, Georgie, you just said you'd been to the Royal Albert Hall, which is a famous concert hall in London.
sentences.ko: 그래서 조지, 방금 런던의 유명한 공연장인 로열 앨버트 홀에 갔었다고 했지.

sentences.en: Why did you go there?
sentences.ko: 거긴 왜 갔어?

sentences.en: I went to a classical music concert, but this was not the first time I've been to the Royal Albert Hall.
sentences.ko: 클래식 음악 공연을 보러 갔는데, 로열 앨버트 홀에 간 게 처음은 아니었어.

sentences.en: No?
sentences.ko: 그래?

sentences.en: No, I actually performed there with my choir last year.
sentences.ko: 응, 사실 작년에 합창단이랑 거기서 공연했었어.

sentences.en: It was... it was amazing.
sentences.ko: 정말... 정말 멋졌어.

sentences.en: Oh wow!
sentences.ko: 와, 대단하다!

sentences.en: Phil, have you visited any famous landmarks in London?
sentences.ko: 필, 너는 런던의 유명한 명소에 가본 적 있어?

sentences.en: Yeah, I think...
sentences.ko: 응, 아마...

sentences.en: I think I've probably visited most of the famous ones.
sentences.ko: 유명한 곳은 거의 다 가본 것 같아.

sentences.en: I've been on the London Eye.
sentences.ko: 런던 아이도 타봤어.

sentences.en: That's the big wheel.
sentences.ko: 그 큰 대관람차 말이야.

sentences.en: I've been to Tower Bridge lots of times.
sentences.ko: 타워 브리지에는 여러 번 갔고.

sentences.en: I've been in the Houses of Parliament.
sentences.ko: 국회의사당 안에도 들어가 봤어.

sentences.en: That's right by Big Ben, where the government is.
sentences.ko: 빅벤 바로 옆에 있는, 정부가 있는 곳이야.

sentences.en: Phil, why have you been in the Houses of Parliament?
sentences.ko: 필, 국회의사당엔 왜 들어갔어?

sentences.en: It was just something for work, so it wasn't that interesting, but it's good to see the building.
sentences.ko: 그냥 일 때문이라 그렇게 재밌진 않았는데, 건물을 보는 건 좋았어.

sentences.en: You see it from outside all the time, and it's kind of interesting to see it from the inside. It's really...
sentences.ko: 밖에서는 항상 보는데, 안에서 보니까 좀 흥미롭더라. 정말...

sentences.en: it's a very beautiful building as well, I think.
sentences.ko: 건물도 아주 아름다운 것 같아.

sentences.en: Yeah, it is. So, you've been to a lot of landmarks in London.
sentences.ko: 맞아, 그렇지. 그럼 런던 명소를 많이 가봤구나.

sentences.en: Do you have a favourite one?
sentences.ko: 제일 좋아하는 곳 있어?

sentences.en: My favourite one is actually the river.
sentences.ko: 제일 좋아하는 건 사실 강이야.

sentences.en: I love going up and down the river on a boat.
sentences.ko: 배 타고 강을 오르내리는 걸 정말 좋아해.

sentences.en: Yeah, I really like the river too.
sentences.ko: 응, 나도 강 정말 좋아해.

sentences.en: My favourite landmark in London is the Tower of London.
sentences.ko: 내가 런던에서 제일 좋아하는 명소는 런던 탑이야.

sentences.en: I went with my dad.
sentences.ko: 아빠랑 같이 갔었어.

sentences.en: It's a very, very old building.
sentences.ko: 아주아주 오래된 건물이야.

sentences.en: I think in history a lot of people died there, so it has a kind of spooky...
sentences.ko: 역사적으로 거기서 많은 사람이 죽었던 것 같아서, 좀 으스스한...

sentences.en: a spooky feeling there.
sentences.ko: 으스스한 느낌이 있어.

sentences.en: But it's quite a large area you can walk around and, yeah, it all just feels really old and quite special.
sentences.ko: 그래도 꽤 넓어서 걸어 다닐 수 있고, 응, 전부 정말 오래되고 꽤 특별한 느낌이야.

sentences.en: OK. So, we've been talking about London, but what about the rest of Britain, Georgie?
sentences.ko: 좋아. 지금까지 런던 얘기를 했는데, 영국의 다른 지역은 어때, 조지?

sentences.en: What's your favourite landmark in the rest of Britain?
sentences.ko: 런던 말고 영국에서 제일 좋아하는 명소는 뭐야?

sentences.en: Ooh, I can't wait to talk about this!
sentences.ko: 오, 이거 얘기하고 싶어서 못 참겠어!

sentences.en: One of my favourite places in the UK is Edinburgh, which is the capital of Scotland.
sentences.ko: 영국에서 제일 좋아하는 곳 중 하나는 스코틀랜드의 수도 에든버러야.

sentences.en: And in the city, they have – in the middle of the city, they have a big black rock, like a hill.
sentences.ko: 도시 한가운데에 큰 검은 바위가 있어, 언덕처럼.

sentences.en: And on the top, there is the castle, Edinburgh Castle, and it's so beautiful.
sentences.ko: 그 꼭대기에 에든버러 성이 있는데, 정말 아름다워.

sentences.en: I used to live there when I was at university and every time I walked past it, I was...
sentences.ko: 대학 다닐 때 거기 살았는데, 그 앞을 지나갈 때마다...

sentences.en: I felt like a tourist every day.
sentences.ko: 매일 관광객이 된 기분이었어.

sentences.en: I was always taking photos of it because it looks unreal.
sentences.ko: 비현실적으로 생겨서 항상 사진을 찍었어.

sentences.en: It doesn't look... It looks like it's from a storybook.
sentences.ko: 꼭... 동화책에서 나온 것 같아.

sentences.en: It's magical, I love it.
sentences.ko: 마법 같아, 정말 좋아.

sentences.en: Yeah, I love Edinburgh.
sentences.ko: 응, 나도 에든버러 정말 좋아해.

sentences.en: I went there one year for New Year and it was...
sentences.ko: 어느 해에 새해를 맞으러 갔었는데...

sentences.en: It's amazing. You can feel the history.
sentences.ko: 정말 멋져. 역사가 느껴져.

sentences.en: There're so many old buildings and it's... yeah, it's very dramatic.
sentences.ko: 오래된 건물이 정말 많고... 응, 아주 극적이야.

sentences.en: I did a guided tour there actually once.
sentences.ko: 사실 거기서 가이드 투어를 한 번 했었어.

sentences.en: It was around Halloween, so it was a kind of spooky-themed guided tour.
sentences.ko: 핼러윈 즈음이라서 좀 으스스한 테마의 가이드 투어였어.

sentences.en: They took us to a graveyard and they told us stories about witches, and that was really exciting.
sentences.ko: 묘지에 데려가서 마녀 이야기를 해줬는데, 정말 신났어.

sentences.en: I like guided tours.
sentences.ko: 나는 가이드 투어가 좋아.

sentences.en: Oh yeah, that sounds exciting.
sentences.ko: 오, 재밌었겠다.

sentences.en: So, Phil, do you enjoy sightseeing?
sentences.ko: 그럼 필, 관광(sightseeing) 좋아해?

sentences.en: So, when you see lots of different landmarks in a city or a country.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 도시나 나라에서 여러 명소를 구경하는 거 말이야.

sentences.en: I do, yes.
sentences.ko: 응, 좋아해.

sentences.en: I think usually when you go sightseeing you see lots of old buildings, usually.
sentences.ko: 관광을 가면 보통 오래된 건물들을 많이 보게 되잖아.

sentences.en: And they often give you an idea of how people used to live, how people lived in the past, and I find that really interesting.
sentences.ko: 그리고 그런 건물들은 사람들이 예전에 어떻게 살았는지, 과거에 어떻게 살았는지 알게 해주는데, 그게 정말 흥미로워.

sentences.en: So yes, if I visit a new city, I almost always go sightseeing at some point.
sentences.ko: 그래서 응, 새로운 도시에 가면 거의 항상 언젠가는 관광을 해.

sentences.en: Yeah, I really like sightseeing as well.
sentences.ko: 응, 나도 관광 정말 좋아해.

sentences.en: You can see lots of a city, or it's the best way to see a place, I think, when you visit somewhere new.
sentences.ko: 도시를 많이 볼 수 있고, 새로운 곳에 갔을 때 그곳을 보는 가장 좋은 방법인 것 같아.

sentences.en: It can be quite exhausting though, can't it?
sentences.ko: 그래도 꽤 지칠 수 있지, 그렇지?

sentences.en: Especially if you're walking all over the city to see all of these different landmarks.
sentences.ko: 특히 여러 명소를 보려고 도시 곳곳을 걸어 다니면 말이야.

sentences.en: So, Phil, my favourite UK landmark is Edinburgh Castle.
sentences.ko: 필, 내가 제일 좋아하는 영국 명소는 에든버러 성이야.

sentences.en: Do you have a favourite?
sentences.ko: 너는 제일 좋아하는 곳 있어?

sentences.en: Yes. I think it's got to be Stonehenge, just because it is so old.
sentences.ko: 응. 스톤헨지일 수밖에 없을 것 같아, 정말 오래됐으니까.

sentences.en: It's thousands of years old.
sentences.ko: 수천 년이나 됐어.

sentences.en: I don't think I've seen anything else that's that old.
sentences.ko: 그렇게 오래된 건 본 적이 없는 것 같아.

sentences.en: Yeah. So, the Stonehenge is in England and it's a circle or a ring of really big, tall stones.
sentences.ko: 응. 스톤헨지는 잉글랜드에 있는데, 정말 크고 높은 돌들이 원 모양으로 둘러서 있어.

sentences.en: And humans put it up and it's really amazing because it's not fully known how they did it, because the rocks are so heavy.
sentences.ko: 사람들이 세운 건데, 돌이 엄청 무거워서 어떻게 세웠는지 아직 완전히 밝혀지지 않아서 정말 놀라워.

sentences.en: So, if anyone comes to the UK to visit, I would really recommend going to see that.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 영국에 놀러 오는 분이 있다면 꼭 가보길 추천해.

sentences.en: So, let's look at some of the words that we talked about today.
sentences.ko: 그럼 오늘 이야기한 단어들을 살펴보자.

sentences.en: And the big one was 'landmark', and those are famous buildings or famous places that people visit, and usually they know what they look like beforehand, often.
sentences.ko: 가장 중요한 건 'landmark'야. 사람들이 방문하는 유명한 건물이나 유명한 장소인데, 보통 가기 전부터 어떻게 생겼는지 아는 경우가 많아.

sentences.en: Yes. For example, the London Eye.
sentences.ko: 맞아. 예를 들면 런던 아이.

sentences.en: We also heard 'sightseeing', which is when you visit landmarks and famous places in a city or country.
sentences.ko: 'sightseeing'도 나왔는데, 도시나 나라의 명소와 유명한 장소를 구경하는 거야.

sentences.en: Yes. And one of the ways that you can do sightseeing is you can go on a guided tour, and that's when someone, a guide, leads you around different places and they tell you about the history of all those places.
sentences.ko: 맞아. 그리고 관광하는 방법 중 하나가 가이드 투어(guided tour)인데, 가이드가 여러 장소로 안내하면서 그곳들의 역사를 알려주는 거야.

sentences.en: So, Georgie, we're out of time.
sentences.ko: 조지, 시간이 다 됐네.

sentences.en: That's it for Real Easy English for this week.
sentences.ko: 이번 주 Real Easy English는 여기까지예요.

sentences.en: But if you like landmarks, make sure you go to our website to check out the London Letter Challenge, where you can see lots of different landmarks and learn easy English.
sentences.ko: 명소를 좋아하신다면 저희 웹사이트에서 'London Letter Challenge'를 꼭 확인해 보세요. 여러 명소를 보면서 쉬운 영어를 배울 수 있어요.

sentences.en: And you can find a free worksheet and transcript on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: 무료 워크시트와 대본은 웹사이트 bbclearningenglish.com에서 찾을 수 있어요.

sentences.en: Goodbye for now.
sentences.ko: 그럼 이만.

sentences.en: Bye!
sentences.ko: 안녕!
